title: Naval units in the Cult look: an indigo gondola with a curled brass prow, an indigo galleon with cream sails and a brass dome, an indigo rowing barge and a brass bathysphere submarine

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a secret-society gondola: the hull becomes long glossy indigo-blue lacquer #4a43b5 with shade #372f8f and a tall polished brass prow #c9a24a curled like a tentacle tip; the red sail becomes a small sail in indigo-blue and pale cream #f3e7c4 stripes; the red pennant becomes one small lantern with a bright green flame at the stern. Nothing red. Keep the mast, boat shape, size, waterline, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The batch-4 cog as the Cult's indigo gondola, on the shared hull's footprint and waterline (CULT.md, Ships; NAVAL_FACTIONS.md).

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a secret-society galleon: the hull becomes indigo-blue wood #4a43b5 with shade #372f8f and polished brass trim #c9a24a; the grey stone tower becomes a round polished brass dome with a small telescope; the red sails become pale cream #f3e7c4 sails, the big one with one indigo eye-in-a-spiral sign; the red pennants become small lanterns with bright green flames. Nothing red. Keep the ship shape, size, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The batch-4 carrack as the Cult's indigo galleon with cream sails and a brass dome.

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a secret-society rowing barge: the hull becomes indigo-blue lacquered wood #4a43b5 with shade #372f8f and a polished brass rim #c9a24a; the red tarp becomes an indigo-blue tarp with a pale cream #f3e7c4 border; the red pennant becomes one candle lantern with a bright green flame on the pole. Nothing red. Keep the oars, boat shape, size, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The batch-4 barge as the Cult's indigo rowing barge.

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a small brass bathysphere submarine lying level, no longer than the boat's hull is now: remove the mast, the striped sail, the pennant and the curled prow; the hull becomes one closed short fat barrel of polished brass #c9a24a with shade #8a6a2a and rows of rivets, one big round porthole glowing bright green in its side, a short brass periscope on top and an indigo-blue tail fin #4a43b5 at the stern. Nothing red. Keep the thick black outline and style, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The accepted Cult Patrol Boat as a brass bathysphere barrel with a green porthole, a periscope and an indigo tail fin (CULT.md, Ships); seated on the shared Submarine's margin and anchor.
